user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Pages visited during user-initiated queries and GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to enhance AI model safety and training.
user_agents.scope: Crawls public web data for AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites directly at user direction to answer questions in Claude AI.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to individual user queries and search requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to enhance search result relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Indexes web content to optimize user search results and responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes and crawl for Google Search and other products.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl image content for Google products and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content for video-related Search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other video-dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content specifically for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, news.google.com, and Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web pages for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including Search Shopping tab.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform Search testing tools crawls.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling by product teams for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites; no specific product affected.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for various internal teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; no specific product affected.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for various internal teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs; no specific product affected.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl site owner requested content for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Building Vertex AI Agents requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content use for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini model training, Gemini Apps, and Vertex AI Gemini grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow rules for User-agent Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects and indexes web information automatically to deliver search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information operating in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features and provides data for Apple ecosystem products and AI.
user_agents.scope: Web search crawling and rendering across the Apple ecosystem.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Determines usage of crawled data for generative AI training without crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Content of websites or apps shared across Meta apps to generate previews.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or improving products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training foundation AI models or direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: User-requested fetches and evaluating AI navigation to complete tasks for users.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web pages to improve Amazon products and services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or noarchive meta tag.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Eligible content appears in search experiences; does not train generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives specific to Amzn-SearchBot or search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information for user queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information for user queries; does not train generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to build open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected sample and subset of the public web.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / under User-agent: CCBot in robots.txt or register for opt-out.
